summary: Toufique Imrose Khalidi, the pioneer of Bangladesh's first digital news service, has passed away at 59 after suffering a brain haemorrhage. He was admitted to a London hospital on Thursday night.

Khalidi was admitted to a hospital in London on Thursday night following a sudden brain haemorrhage. Doctors worked to save him, but he was pronounced dead at 2:23 PM local time on Friday.

headline: Jamaat leader Akhtaruzzaman arrested over airport assault and disorder
summary: The former MP is accused of threatening the airport chief and assaulting a security supervisor over Zamzam water distribution delays.
details: Jamaat-e-Islami leader and former MP Major (retd) Akhtaruzzaman Ranjan has been taken into custody by the Detective Branch (DB) of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police.
The arrest follows an incident at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport where he allegedly threatened the airport's executive director and assaulted a security supervisor.
A viral video shows Akhtaruzzaman berating Executive Director SM Ragib Samad, threatening to 'grab him by the neck and throw him out' over delays in distributing Zamzam water to Umrah pilgrims.
The FIR alleges that he also hit security supervisor Md Kamal Uddin and flung passengers' Zamzam water bottles off trolleys after being told not to film in a restricted area.
A Dhaka court has accepted the case and sought a probe report by November 10.
Separately, Biman Bangladesh Airlines has suspended two officials—baggage in-charge Monirul Islam Pradhan and flight supervisor Saddam Hossain—due to the distribution delays.
caption:
Threatening to 'grab by the neck' and assaulting staff—Jamaat leader Akhtaruzzaman arrested after airport chaos.

Jamaat-e-Islami leader and former MP Major (retd) Akhtaruzzaman Ranjan has been taken into custody by the Detective Branch (DB) of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police.

The arrest follows an incident at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport where he allegedly threatened the airport's executive director and assaulted a security supervisor.

A viral video shows Akhtaruzzaman berating Executive Director SM Ragib Samad, threatening to 'grab him by the neck and throw him out' over delays in distributing Zamzam water to Umrah pilgrims.

The FIR alleges that he also hit security supervisor Md Kamal Uddin and flung passengers' Zamzam water bottles off trolleys after being told not to film in a restricted area.

A Dhaka court has accepted the case and sought a probe report by November 10.

Separately, Biman Bangladesh Airlines has suspended two officials—baggage in-charge Monirul Islam Pradhan and flight supervisor Saddam Hossain—due to the distribution delays.
